issues.description: The template defines the Grover-construction method as build_grover(...) but the template's run() calls self.grover_circuit(...). The solution implements grover_circuit(...). This identifier mismatch (build_grover vs grover_circuit) across template and solution will confuse students and likely cause AttributeError or prevent the provided run() example from working if students implement only the method name appearing in the template stub.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) (or change run() to call build_grover(...)) so the template, solution, and example run() use the same identifier. Update any task references or docstrings to match the chosen name.
